recommendation: Keep the commit. Future ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition structural maintenance belongs in the Administrative Incubator source, but the active core Library and Invoice diagram surfaces needed this reconciliation to avoid publishing stale invoice-specific price-component model metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-16380 was Published/Persuasive for R5. It requested turning the reusable PriceComponent structure into a metadata type, ultimately named MonetaryComponent, making it valid for extension values and using it for ChargeItem.unitPriceComponent, ChargeItem.totalPriceComponent, ChargeItemDefinition.propertyGroup.priceComponent, Invoice.lineItem.priceComponent, and Invoice.totalPriceComponent.
initial_application: The main source application had already occurred: 5c52eddab2 added source/datatypes/monetarycomponent.xml and fhir.ini registration, and ee6690b2be changed Invoice StructureDefinition priceComponent elements to MonetaryComponent. ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition were later removed from active core inputs, and the combined branch already included FHIR-21001 commit da0a54d378 aligning ChargeItem ModelInfo. The remaining gap was active Library/FHIR-ModelInfo and FHIRHelpers content still using Invoice.PriceComponent, ChargeItemDefinition.PriceComponent, and InvoicePriceComponentType.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps monetarycomponent, Invoice, and Library active in core while ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition now live outside active core. The current Administrative Incubator CI StructureDefinitions for ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition use MonetaryComponent for the relevant pricing elements. Later FHIR-44610, with FHIR-37946 closed as duplicate, clarified PriceComponentType definitions without reversing the shared MonetaryComponent modeling.
reconciliation: Updated Library/FHIR-ModelInfo so Invoice.lineItem.priceComponent, Invoice.totalPriceComponent, and ChargeItemDefinition.propertyGroup.priceComponent reference FHIR.MonetaryComponent; removed the stale local PriceComponent class infos and InvoicePriceComponentType conversion metadata; changed FHIRHelpers to expose ToString for FHIR.PriceComponentType; and updated the checked-in Invoice SVG's displayed price-component label and links to MonetaryComponent/PriceComponentType.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: Replaced stale Invoice.PriceComponent and ChargeItemDefinition.PriceComponent model references with FHIR.MonetaryComponent and removed InvoicePriceComponentType conversion metadata.
source/library/library-fhir-helpers-content.cql: Changed the helper ToString overload from FHIR.InvoicePriceComponentType to FHIR.PriceComponentType.
source/invoice/invoice.svg: Updated the checked-in Invoice diagram label and links for the displayed price-component box to MonetaryComponent and PriceComponentType.
